parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family inet address 172.17.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 1 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external

set protocols bgp group external local-a.command: set protocols bgp group external local-address 172.17.1.2

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 172.17.1.1 peer-as 100

set protocols bgp group external family.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group external family.command: set protocols bgp group external family inet unicast

parameters.name: address-family
parameters.explanation: BGP组支持的地址族，例如inet unicast。

set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement IMPORT-DIRECT term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.template: set policy-options policy-statement [policy-statement-name] term [term-number] from protocol [protocol-name]
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.explanation: Configures a policy statement to match routes from a specific protocol in a specific term

parameters.name: policy-statement-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement

parameters.name: term-number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: protocol-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the protocol to match routes from

set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.command: set policy-options policy-statement IMPORT-DIRECT term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement IMPO.explanation: Configures a routing policy statement to accept routes under specified conditions

parameters.name: policy-statement
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement

parameters.name: term-number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken (e.g., accept, reject)

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 172.17.1.1 import IMPORT-DIRECT
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [group_name] neighbor [neighbor_ip] import [import_policy]
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.explanation: Configure BGP protocol to set import policy for a neighbor in a specific group

parameters.name: neighbor_ip
parameters.explanation: IP address of the BGP neighbor

parameters.name: import_policy
parameters.explanation: Name of the import policy to apply to the neighbor
